(def ^number compare
  "Comparator. Returns a negative number, zero, or a positive number
  when x is logically 'less than', 'equal to', or 'greater than'
  y. Uses IComparable if available and google.array.defaultCompare for objects
 of the same type and special-cases nil to be less than any other object."
  (let [default-compare__ (fn [a b]
                           (if (cljs.core/> a b)
                             1
                             (if (cljs.core/< a b) -1 0)))]
    (fn [x y]
      (cond
        (cljs.core/== x y) 0
        (suss.bootstrap/nil? x) -1
        (suss.bootstrap/nil? y) 1
        (suss.bootstrap/number? x)
        (if (suss.bootstrap/number? y)
          (default-compare__ x y)
          (let [compare-x-text__ (str_ x)
                        compare-y-text__ (str_ y)]
                    (throw (suss.bootstrap/error
                             (.join (cljs.core/array "Cannot compare " compare-x-text__
                                                    " to " compare-y-text__) "")))))
        (satisfies? IComparable x) (-compare x y)
        :else
        (if (and (or (suss.bootstrap/string? x) (array? x)
                     (cljs.core/== x true) (cljs.core/== x false))
                 (cljs.core/== (type x) (type y)))
          (default-compare__ x y)
          (let [compare-x-text__ (str_ x)
                        compare-y-text__ (str_ y)]
                    (throw (suss.bootstrap/error
                             (.join (cljs.core/array "Cannot compare " compare-x-text__
                                                    " to " compare-y-text__) "")))))))))
